text:
alex: heads-up — customer reports 403 on OAuth callback (GitHub/Google). They get 'state mismatch' and the `state` query param looks truncated on return. Repro steps they gave: click sign-in -> provider -> provider redirects to https://app.redwood.example/auth/callback/github?code=...&state=LONG_JWT but our server log shows a much shorter state. request_id=r-88f3. Can eng/sre take a look?
maria: can you paste the exact raw redirect URL the customer sent and which region/ingress they hit? does this happen on desktop too or only mobile?
alex: customer says intermittent, mainly on mobile webview (iOS). desktop usually OK. They pasted this: `https://app.redwood.example/auth/callback/github?code=abc123&state=eyJhbGc...` but our access log entry shows `state=eyJhbGci` (cut). UA they sent: `Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_6 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/15E148`.
tim: smells like proxy/ingress rewrite or URL length limit. We had a CF-worker that rewrites mobile deeplink fragments recently. I'll grep ingress and LB rules. assigning to eng-infra.
maria: also consider cookie/chunking — our state is a compact JWT sometimes >2k if we embed extra claims. webviews + some proxies will truncate long query strings. can you repro on staging with a long state token?
alex: tested on staging with a 4k `state` in an iOS simulator webview — reproduced. truncated at ~2048 chars and `+` became space in one run. error printed: `oauth: state mismatch`.
tim: found an ingress rule: mobile UA branch that runs a small rewrite to normalize fragments. config had a `proxy_max_uri_length` ~2048 and a worker that strips what it thinks are trailing path segments. disabling the mobile rewrite in canary now.
maria: short-term mitigation: generate shorter state nonces (store metadata server-side keyed by short id) or compress the JWT. long-term: adjust ingress to not truncate queries and add tests for long query strings. we should add logging to compare generated vs received state.
oauth-bot: deploy started — ingress-canary: ingress-can-374 (disabling mobile-rewrite)
tim: canary is up. alex, can you ask customer to retry and include full `Referer`/`Location` headers if it still fails? also ask them to clear webview cookies.
alex: pinged customer with repro steps and a staging link to try. asked for full redirect headers and their exact UA string.
maria: after confirm, add a support KB article: "OAuth state truncated by mobile proxy/webview" with workaround (shorten state, clear cookies, use native SSO). also add alert: count of state length mismatches by UA.
tim: follow-ups on infra: 1) add unit test for ingress rewrite handling of long query strings 2) raise `proxy_max_uri_length` in prod 3) add telemetry for truncated state events.
alex: :thumbsup: keeping thread open until customer confirms. thanks all.
